d: We are seeking strategic, detail-oriented, and results-driven professionals to lead regulatory compliance activities, oversee corporate governance standards, and ensure organizational operations align with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. Successful candidates will play a key role in developing compliance frameworks, managing regulatory risks, strengthening internal controls, and promoting a culture of accountability and ethical business conduct.
r: Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive regulatory compliance strategies, policies, and procedures.
Lead compliance functions and ensure business activities adhere to applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards.
Monitor changes in laws, regulations, and regulatory guidance that may affect organizational operations.
Establish and maintain compliance frameworks, internal controls, and governance processes.
Identify, assess, and manage regulatory, operational, and corporate compliance risks.
Provide strategic guidance to senior management and relevant departments on compliance matters.
Coordinate regulatory audits, internal reviews, compliance assessments, and reporting activities.
Oversee the preparation and submission of regulatory documentation, disclosures, and required reports.
Develop compliance monitoring programs and evaluate the effectiveness of existing control procedures.
Lead investigations into potential policy violations, regulatory concerns, and compliance-related incidents.
Work with legal, finance, risk management, operations, and other departments to address compliance requirements.
Establish corrective action plans and monitor the implementation of compliance improvements.
Promote ethical business practices, transparency, accountability, and organizational integrity.
Develop and coordinate compliance training programs to strengthen regulatory awareness across the organization.
Maintain accurate compliance records, risk registers, audit findings, and regulatory documentation.
Present compliance updates, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Support business initiatives by evaluating regulatory implications and recommending appropriate compliance measures.
Degree or relevant professional qualification in Law, Business Administration, Finance, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks, corporate governance, and risk management principles.
Knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, industry standards, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Strong leadership, strategic planning, and organizational management abilities.
Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex regulatory matters.
Ability to develop compliance policies, procedures, monitoring frameworks, and internal control systems.
Strong knowledge of audit coordination, risk assessment, regulatory reviews, and compliance reporting.
Familiarity with compliance management systems, governance tools, and risk monitoring platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to present regulatory matters and compliance recommendations clearly to senior management.
Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and investigation skills.
High level of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments and external regulatory stakeholders.
Strong commitment to ethical conduct, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.

d: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 31 properties, including 33 signature F&B restaurants, across the Middle East, Europe, Asia and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and luxury residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

Jumeirah Messilah Beach is uniquely located in a secluded area with easy access to Kuwait’s Central Business District, airport, and major Kuwait attractions. The resort features 316 rooms and suites, 79 residential suites, and 10 villas, totalling 405 units. The beachfront hotel features an impressive array of exceptional dining destinations, including the Garden Café all-day dining restaurant, Pepper Steakhouse, Olio Trattoria Italiana, Mint Café, and The Lobby Lounge for a relaxing afternoon tea.

Setting new standards for holistic relaxation and luxurious comfort, the award-winning Talise Spa at Jumeirah Messilah Beach features a stunning Himalayan Salt Room, the first of its kind in the Middle East, built with pure crystal salt in its natural state. The spa also comprises dedicated ladies' and men’s areas with an extensive range of treatment rooms, including two private suites.
Superior conference and banqueting facilities mark Jumeirah Messilah Beach as the perfect venue for meetings and events.
q: Education & Experience: High school diploma required; associate’s degree or college coursework preferred. Prior experience in administrative, front office, or guest-facing roles is essential.
Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, strong interpersonal skills, and a professional demeanor when interacting with guests, vendors and team members.
Organization & Time Management: Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Confidentiality & Problem-Solving: Capable of handling sensitive information with discretion, demonstrating sound judgment, multitasking ability, and a proactive approach to solving day-to-day challenges.
r: An opportunity has arisen for a Guest Service Assistant to join Telecommunication at Jumeirah Messilah Beach. The main duties and responsibilities of this role:

Answer all calls promptly and professionally according to departmental standards, maintaining a professional tone of voice and using standardized English and phrases. Assist with requests or direct them to the appropriate department or room number.

Handle all incoming and outgoing faxes, messages for in-house and expected guests, and follow up on all relevant duties and requests. Ensure all requests are handled in a timely manner and follow up to ensure guest satisfaction.
Efficiently manage all emergencies and ensure requests are addressed promptly, escalating guest satisfaction issues to senior colleagues immediately.

Attend and participate in daily briefings, read and understand daily updates, and manage guest requests and reports through Service One and HotSOS. Ensure smooth shift handovers and maintain accurate records of all activities.
Accurately record, check, and hand over wake-up calls, ensuring all calls are made on time and recorded clearly.
x: We offer an attractive tax-free salary, paid in dinar (KWD), the local currency of Kuwait. In addition, we offer generous F&B benefits, reduced hotel rates across our properties globally, 30 days of annual leave, flights home, live-out and transportation allowances, life insurance, an Incentive Management Scheme, and other employee benefits, making the role attractive to high performers and any applicant looking for a career with one of the most luxurious brands in the hospitality industry.

d: This position assists the Brand Manager in planning product and assortment strategies that meet or exceed financial goals. It involves coordinating all activities related to the allocation and delivery of merchandise across stores in the region, supporting pre-season financial planning, in-season forecasting, open-to-buy management, and budgeting for new store openings. The role also ensures a balanced collection at store level, along with timely replenishments and inter-store transfers.
q: 2-5 years of experience in retail merchandising or a similar role within the fashion or lifestyle industry.
Proficient in inventory management systems, MS Excel, and PowerPoint.
Strong understanding of product strategy, vendor coordination, range development, and trend analysis.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Operations, Merchandising, or a related field is preferred.
r: Assist in developing merchandise plans for categories based on historical trends, sales performance, and future outlooks provided by the brand team.
Analyze store profiles using key reports such as stock weeks, sales blend, and inventory by grade to support allocation decisions.
Execute in-season stock analysis and balancing, markdown management, and stock vs. sales performance reviews.
Plan merchandise mix and execute initial allocations and reserve management based on pre-distribution plans.
Finalize seasonal assortment plans and size run books in collaboration with the Senior Merchandiser.
Monitor competitor brands' product lines, pricing, and category developments.
Ensure compliance with stock ageing standards and maintain stock turns in line with company policy.
Support margin negotiations, order placements, and stock distribution decisions.
Monitor bestsellers and slow movers, taking timely actions to drive performance.
Track actual sales versus forecasts and coordinate inventory checks and replenishments based on store-level needs and upcoming events.
Conduct regular market visits with the Brand Manager to assess store execution and gather competitor intelligence.
Provide post-season feedback reports on product categories.
Participate in seasonal markdown and sales planning in collaboration with the Category/Brand Manager.
